analysis: Examined both workflow excerpts and the complete changed-range map. The changes set DARKBLOOM_PROVIDER_TOOLCHAIN=release globally (.github/workflows/release-provider.yml head 112–114) and change the older-macOS validation artifact's required SDK from 27.0 to 27.2 (patch head 1444, base 1441). No supported regression is apparent: the SDK check remains exact, and surrounding source preserves source verification before credential-consuming jobs (head 146–185), build/qualification prerequisites for signing (330–334), unsigned source/version verification (445–465), and retained-artifact digest binding and registration-before-alias-publication in the base excerpt (1134–1163, 1268–1285, 1383–1402). These are relevant to A-005, A-011, A-017 and T-054; release publication must still not be mistaken for serving qualification under TB-011/T-052. No direct changes to request encryption, cache scope, attestation grants, billing, local helper authority or plaintext handling are shown. Integration must examine scripts/prepare-provider-release-toolchain.sh and the provider-release-build action to verify that the new global selector consistently chooses 27.2 for build, qualification and signing, and that recorded build_sdk_version matches the actual SDK, including retained-build recovery. Those implementations and the head publication tail are outside these supplied excerpts; the unchanged surrounding workflow does not establish their behavior.
